text: Quite a goose egg. What were you doing? Wrestling with that lamp?
Hey, hey. Oh, it's very funny. I don't know what happened.
Suddenly the damn lamp crashed down on top of my head.
I just finished tightening the screws.
I'm fine. I'm going to go upstairs, get cleaned up, put on some new clothes.
How about some dinner? What would you like?
Maybe some tuna or a salad or something.
Then let's call it a night.
That sounds good. I'm kind of tired.
See you downstairs in about ten minutes?
